Found 21 items in registries @pipecat:

Showing items 1-21 of 21:

- connect-button (registry:component) - One button for the whole session lifecycle, driven by the Pipecat transport state. Every state's label, icon, style, and action can be overridden sparsely. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- audio-visualizer-bar (registry:component) - Canvas-2D audio spectrum visualizer with mel-scale bands and the shared visualizer lifecycle states (connecting, silent, speaking, thinking). Headless view for any MediaStreamTrack, plus a Pipecat-connected wrapper. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- audio-visualizer-radial (registry:component) - Canvas-2D radial audio visualizer: a ring of spokes growing outward with mel-scale voice bands, sharing the kit visualizer lifecycle states (connecting, silent, speaking, thinking). Headless view for any MediaStreamTrack, plus a Pipecat-connected wrapper. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- audio-visualizer-wave (registry:component) - Shader aura audio visualizer with optional dithering: swirling ribbons of turbulent light that animate between the shared visualizer lifecycle states (connecting, silent, speaking, thinking), with the aura swelling on live volume. Ships its own Shadertoy-compatible WebGL runtime. Headless view for any MediaStreamTrack, plus a Pipecat-connected wrapper. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- device-select (registry:component) - Media device picker for microphones, speakers, or cameras — as a select or a dropdown menu around any trigger. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-audio-control (registry:component) - Microphone control with toggle and push-to-talk modes, live audio visualizer, and a mic/speaker device picker in a split-button dropdown. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-video-control (registry:component) - Camera toggle with preview tile and camera picker in a split-button dropdown. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- user-screen-control (registry:component) - Screen-share toggle with a preview tile while sharing. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- bot-audio (registry:component) - Bot audio output element with a shared volume store, mute toggle, horizontal or vertical volume slider, and a popover volume control. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- conversation (registry:component) - Live scrolling transcript of the user/agent conversation with role labels, karaoke text rendering, function-call cards, and connection-aware empty states. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- text-input (registry:component) - Message composer with inline send button that injects the message into the conversation and sends it to the bot. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- transcript-overlay (registry:component) - Caption-style overlay for bot speech with word-by-word fade-in and turn-end fade-out. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- client-status (registry:component) - Client and agent connection status rows, live-updated from transport state and bot lifecycle events. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- session-info (registry:component) - Session metadata rows: transport type, copyable ids, RTVI client/server versions. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dtmf-keypad (registry:component) - Telephone keypad that sends DTMF tones — buffered sequence entry or immediate per-key dialing, with synthesized press feedback. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-pipecat-app (registry:hook) - Client bootstrap hook with an explicit transport factory, connect/disconnect lifecycle, startBot handling and error state. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-pipecat-metrics (registry:hook) - Shared store of RTVI metrics: per-processor ttfb/ttfa/processing/characters/stt_usage series with a rolling cap, running token totals (incl. cache-read and reasoning), and session-scoped reset. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-pipecat-event-stream (registry:hook) - Shared RTVI event log: rAF-batched capture with a rolling cap, pause, clear-on-reconnect, and per-subscriber filtering and grouping. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- metric (registry:component) - Single-datapoint metric tile — label, big tabular value, optional unit — fully generic and props-driven, chart-free by design. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- metrics (registry:block) - Metrics dashboard block with a Performance/Usage tab navigator: per-processor latency tiles and charts, plus running token/character/audio usage totals, on the stock shadcn chart (recharts). [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- console (registry:block) - Workbench for debugging and testing Pipecat agents: connect flow, bot media, conversation and metrics, device and session info, and a live RTVI event stream, with a tabbed mobile layout. [@pipecat] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
